\par\noindent{\footnotesize\textit{Notes.} Panel A uses pooled EU27 country-year variation. Split SBTI and accounting are separate 64-scenario designs. The 32-scenario accounting design fixes initial carve-outs. Panel B uses 500 joint draws and 32 scenarios. The proposal ratio divides point scenario spread by the preferred scenario's 90\% parameter interval width. The Monte Carlo has two windows. In this reference the SBTI axis is redundant: on and off cells agree exactly, so 64 diagnostic rows do not represent 64 varying policies. Historical six-factor capacity results remain separately reproducible.}\par
